name: Andrés Garay
bio: Andrés Garay is a film director and stop-motion animator based in Mexico City. He graduated from the Faculty of Arts and Design at UNAM and is currently studying Cinematography at the Centro de Capacitación Cinematográfica (CCC). In 2017, he began his career with his YouTube channel GarayRecords! and has since directed several short films, including "Once Upon a Time in New York", "Revolution", "What Disappears",  "Monero" and "They Came for the Dogs", which received a wide festival selection, including Pixelatl, Shorts México, and won the award for Best Animated Short Film at FICAA.

credits.overview: Gabriel waters and tends to Karla every day, ever since hundreds of flowers began to sprout from her body. But now, the flowers are withering. If they do not leave their home, Karla will not survive.

credits.title: Vinieron por los perros
credits.overview: A lonely alien travels across the universe hoping somewhere to find what he wants most... to know if he is completely alone or if there is something more. And after traveling for a long time through different galaxies, stars and planets without finding anything, everything changes when he arrives on planet Earth.
